The fix replaces the two-step sequence with a single atomic call to AtomicLong.incrementAndGet(), which guarantees the increment happens atomically. The CounterServiceConcurrencyTest validates the fix by spinning up 1000 threads and asserting the counter reaches exactly 1000, confirming no updates are lost.</narrative>
